Failing tests are left failing on purpose — they reproduce the confirmed breaks.

ATTACK BOUNDARIES PROBED (18): (1) mobile/Edge/SQL golden-fixture parity; (2) empty evidence → unranked, never Bronze; (3) 1-analysis window + confidence weight; (4) NaN/±Inf/negative/>10 scores; (5) low_confidence ⇒ no score / no rank contribution; (6) partial rows never chargeable/scored; (7) duplicate ids + conflicting replay order; (8) captured_at grammar/bounds; (9) shot_type length/whitespace; (10) definitionVersion provenance / no benchmark rescale; (11) missing/withdrawn/expired/not-yet-valid/half-approved release authority; (12) release-policy storage failure & slow read; (13) authority blocks scored while non-scored settles; (14) SQL recompute_player_rank parity with TS; (15) corrupt persisted rank state; (16) network loss / slow response / double action / account switch on rank & sync routes; (17) engine hostile measurements; (18) pipeline empty/short input. 109 test cases total (Jest 55+15, Deno 12+11, SQL 16 probes).

RUNS (all VERIFIED on this Linux box, Node 22 / Deno 2.9.6 / postgres:16 throwaway container `pickle-audit` on 127.0.0.1:55432 with shim_auth.sql + every migration applied):

PASSING ATTACKS (no break; evidence):
— Edge release authority (adv_analysis_scoring_release_sync.test.ts): A1 withdrawnAt in the past with deny switch still false → scored refused access.release_not_authorized; A2 validFrom in the future → refused; A3/A3b only benchmark / only mechanics approved → refused; A4 withdrawal scheduled in the future leaves policy active; A6 same scored id twice WITHOUT authority → two typed rejections, zero settlements; A7 1.2 s slow authority read still settles (no premature 503); A8 account switch: B's /v1/rank right after A's cached read issues B's own user-filtered queries; A9 score literals -0 and 1e1 accepted, 10.000000000000002 / "7.5" / null(scored) refused at parseSyncShot. Also (existing release_policy_admission + my A-suite): storage unavailable → 503, never authorized.
— Edge rank route (adv_analysis_scoring_rank_route.test.ts): R3 NaN/'abc'/Infinity technique scores → { rank: null }; R3 saved row with no technique evidence → unranked wins; R4 inline fallback reproduces computePlayerRank for every golden case; R5 technique-view failure → 503; R5 saved-state read failure → 503 (no silent recompute); R6 concurrent GETs share one verdict within TTL.
